---
title: "Embla"
subtitle: "Plotly presentation recipes · Plot Demo and Usage Tutorial"
---

Embla provides Plotly presentation recipes and guidance that people and agents
can follow. Browse by chart type in [Plot Demo](outputs/index.qmd), then copy
the shared layout recipe and interaction config from [Usage Tutorial](usage.qmd)
into your own project.

[Colors](outputs/themes.qmd) collects the 5-, 10-, and 20-color sequences in light
and dark appearances. Plotly cycles through each sequence when there are more
series than colors.

The presentation recipes cover legends, animation controls, and figure layout.
The consuming project owns scientific data, units, axis ranges, calculations,
and geometry. The current colors and layouts remain **CONVERGING** candidates
for visual evaluation.
